facts.fact: TechPark CV, a EUR 45.59 million AfDB-funded technology park with campuses in Praia and Mindelo, was being inaugurated on 5-6 May 2025, per TechAfrica News.
TechPark CV currently hosts 23 companies, with capacity for up to 1,500 workers, per TechAfrica News.

note: No incubation programme or cohort is stated, so no in-service programme or multi-city fact.
